_coverage_notes_page_7_and_8: SCOPE. 79 of this form's 425 fields are on pages 7 and 8 - 50 and 29 - and this fixture reaches every one of the 77 that are bound. The other 2 are Date_Signed_1[0] and Date_Signed_2[0], which are declared never auto-filled and which no fixture may reach: a date beside a signature line states when a person signed a declaration made under penalty of perjury.

EVERY SECTION 9 QUESTION IS ANSWERED YES, and that is a coverage decision rather than a portrait. Each of the twelve Yes/No pairs on the two pages gates a block of follow-up cells, and a No leaves that block correctly empty - which is a valid filing and reaches none of the cells this fixture exists to reach. Answering Yes throughout makes every follow-up cell coherent with the question above it; the resulting taxpayer has an unusually eventful decade.

THE OFFER CALCULATION IS THE POINT OF PAGE 7 AND EVERY FIGURE IN IT IS DERIVED FROM FIGURES ALREADY ON THE FORM. Box F is 8,195 on page 6, so both page-7 copies are 8,195, Box G is 8,195 x 12 = 98,340 and Box H is 8,195 x 24 = 196,680. Box A is 444,752 and Box B is 128,890, so the combined cell is 573,642. The Box-G-or-Box-H cell takes Box G, the 5-or-fewer-payments branch, and the Offer Amount is 573,642 + 98,340 = 671,982. Every one of those is a typed figure here and a RECOMPUTATION off the filled PDF in gate step 11 - the two sides are a hand-typed JSON and page bytes.

THE BOX-G-OR-BOX-H CELL IS NOT CHECKED BY ANY TRIPWIRE and cannot be. Which of the two applies is the payment term, which this form prints no cell for; it is chosen on Form 656 Section 4. The cell carries a review-page advisory instead, and this fixture exercises that advisory by writing the cell.

ALL FOURTEEN ATTACHMENT BOXES ARE TICKED. That exercises every check_here target on page 8 in one run, which no partial answer would. Whether a tick asserting "this document is enclosed" should be driven from an intake record at all is carried open as C-18: nothing on this form and nothing in this engine can see the envelope.

_drives._what_this_block_is: One entry per floor declared in adapters/pdf/maps/433aoi.totals.json. DRIVABLE means a record obeying the printed instructions of the form can make the sum of the PRINTED operands negative. The FIVE marked NOT DRIVABLE are structural: every printed operand feeding them is either a non-negative input cell, a line that is itself floored, or a floored line times a printed multiplier, so their sum is non-negative for every legal record and no fixture can exercise them. Six of the eleven fire here.
_drives.6b: DRIVABLE, driven. Vehicle 1 is LEASED, so printed (6a) is the constant 0 the caption draws; 0 - printed constant 3,450 = -3,450, printed as 0.
_drives.Box B: NOT DRIVABLE. Box B = (8) + (11). (8) is a sum of account balances and a digital-asset figure, none of which the form permits to be negative; (11) is itself floored and therefore prints 0 or more. Their sum is non-negative for every legal record. This floor is declared and cannot be exercised by any fixture.
_drives.Box D: NOT DRIVABLE. Box D adds lines (30) through (38). Eight are input cells the form instructs must not be negative and (36) carries Box C, which is itself floored. Driving Box D negative requires printing a negative number in a cell the form forbids, which would make the fixture illegal rather than exercise the floor.
_drives.Box E: NOT DRIVABLE. Box E adds lines (39) through (51), thirteen input cells the form instructs must not be negative. Same argument as Box D.
_drives.Box F: DRIVABLE, driven. Box D 17,819 - Box E 23,114 = -5,295, printed as 0.
_drives.Box G: NOT DRIVABLE. Box G is the page-7 copy of Box F times the printed multiplier 12, and Box F is itself floored at 0, so the product is non-negative for every record. The floor restates Box F’s rather than adding a reachable one; it is declared because the page prints "Do not enter a number less than $0" and not because the arithmetic could reach it. On this fixture Box F is 0, so Box G is 0 - at the floor, not below it.
_drives.Box H: NOT DRIVABLE, for the same reason as Box G, with a printed multiplier of 24.

_also_exercises: The vehicle branch swap - vehicle 1 leased, vehicle 2 owned - is the OPPOSITE branch to the acceptance fixture, so the predicates "6a leased" and "6c own" are held here and nowhere else. It is here rather than in a third fixture because driving (6b) below zero requires the leased branch anyway: an owned vehicle with equity under $3,450 would drive the same floor, but the leased branch drives it AND holds a predicate no fixture has held.
_every_total_here_is_typed: Every total in this file is a typed number, as in any fixture. Nothing verifies it here. Step 11 of the gate recomputes each one from the operands it reads back off the FILLED PDF and fails on any disagreement, so the typed figures are the claim and the gate is the check - the two sides are a hand-typed JSON and a recomputation from page bytes, never one derivation compared with itself.
